Author: dexcss
Name: Glamour Sorter
Description: Sorts glamour-able gear from your inventory into the Glamour Dresser as outfit glamours — including seasonal sets, with the Store as Outfit Glamour checkbox dialog automated. Completes existing outfit sets instead of creating duplicates, and leaves true duplicates in your bags to sell. Open your Glamour Dresser, run /gsort, review the preview, then store.
